FEATURED

Project BlindEye

Personal Project · 2025

Vision device for the visually impaired

Glasses that use AI to narrate the surrounding environment to the user

▶ Watch the demo video
GOAL
Build a pair of glasses that could be worn anywhere and describe the wearer's surroundings in real time.
HOW IT WORKS
The Seeed XIAO ESP32S3 hosts a web server carrying a live video feed. A laptop pulls that stream and runs Ultralytics YOLO object detection alongside custom Python code to identify relevant objects and their positions, which then get narrated to the user.
RESULT
The core goal was nearly met — the detection and narration pipeline worked as intended — but the three-month build window meant the glasses still depend on a Wi-Fi connection, so they aren't yet usable just anywhere. A second version aimed at closing that gap is in progress.
Seeed XIAO ESP32S3C++PythonAutoCADUltralytics YOLOWi-FiBluetooth
PROJECT

Automated Pet Feeder

Personal Project

Water and food dispenser managed online

Check bowl levels and refill from any device on the network

GOAL
Wirelessly access a user interface, see the contents of the bowls, and choose when to dispense more food or water.
HOW IT WORKS
An ESP32 hosts a web server with the interface, showing jug and bowl levels plus a refill option for each bowl. A water pump handles water, a stepper motor turns the 3D-printed auger for food, and weight sensors under the bowls report how full they are.
RESULT
Successful prototype, with the whole enclosure designed in CAD.
ESP32CAD3D printingLoad cells + HX711Stepper motorWeb server
